projects.name: betorskip
projects.description: Paste a bet slip, get BET, SKIP or CHECK: read by a local Gemma, every number checked against the slip and its own arithmetic, decided by your bankroll rules.

projects.name: dapraia
projects.description: The hour to go outside tomorrow, in one line: an open forecast, your own words read by Gemma 4 on your machine, and a window picked by plain code.

projects.name: whatran
projects.description: What your coding agents ran in your terminal today: atuin and Claude Code history, flagged by fixed rules, explained by Gemma 4 on your own machine.

projects.name: conversion-preflight
projects.description: Preflight agent for Google and Meta offline conversion uploads: rules from a Sanity knowledge base, declared rules from a Sanity dataset, digests from tested code.

projects.name: taint-trail
projects.description: Follows an untrusted GitHub Actions value after it leaves run:, through env:, with:, step outputs and into the called action, until it dies in argv, reaches a shell, spoofs GITHUB_OUTPUT, or becomes opaque with the reason named. An injection that moved is not an injection that was fixed.

projects.name: revenue-loop
projects.description: Closed-loop revenue attribution: when a CRM deal is won, the conversion reaches Google and Meta exactly once, attributed, or it is quarantined with a reason

projects.name: sequence-gate
projects.description: Decide whether the next step of a follow-up sequence may fire: stop before the send, idempotent per case and step, quiet hours in the contact's timezone, caps across sequences, escalation that ends with a person.

projects.name: before-you-give
projects.description: Hear what a nonprofit's public tax filings say before you donate. No score, no guessing.

projects.name: ghl-bridge
projects.description: Policy-gated bridge between a HighLevel workspace and AI automation: event-keyed webhook idempotency, an approval gate no draft can route past, doctrine-grade dedupe, and rate limits proven offline against a deterministic fake.

projects.name: on-behalf
projects.description: Permission-aware RAG that asks the source, as the user, at query time. OBO token broker, Graph and Drive semantics as deterministic fakes, entitlement before top-k, and the snapshot index that leaks by design so the tests can prove it.

projects.name: tenant-fence
projects.description: Multi-tenant RAG retrieval where cross-tenant leakage is impossible by construction: entitlement filtering applied before the candidate set is scored, proven by an adversarial suite in CI.

projects.name: langgraph-production
projects.description: A LangGraph support agent with the reliability layer around it: routing measured against labelled fixtures, a human gate before irreversible tools, durable resume with exactly-once effects, and a CI gate that fails when a number moves.

projects.name: make-failsafe
projects.description: Error handling patterns for Make.com scenarios that refuse to die silently: a tested FastAPI decision service plus importable draft blueprints for ERP to 3PL flows

projects.name: confidence-gate
projects.description: A trust gate for LLM output: validate structure, score confidence from external signals, and route to auto-accept, human review, or abstain.

projects.name: grounding-probe
projects.description: Does the RAG answer use the retrieved context, or just agree with it? Counterfactual grounding check: ablate the evidence, re-run the generator, read the verdict.

projects.name: token-ledger
projects.description: Per-query token ledger for LLM pipelines: record what the API reports, answer with one GROUP BY. Zero dependencies, dashboard included.

projects.name: lead-quorum
projects.description: Distributed multi-agent lead qualifier on Google ADK + A2A: cross-model corroboration, auditable scoring, abstains instead of guessing

projects.name: crosswatch
projects.description: Cross-source corroboration and scheduled scoring for data you cannot trust from one provider. Zero dependencies, config-driven scheduler, scores that explain themselves.

projects.name: ai-in-practice
projects.description: Free 84-page handbook on applied AI: LLMs, local models, RAG, agents, MCP, fine-tuning, evals. From zero to working agent.

projects.name: cloudrun-pipeline
projects.description: Take a data pipeline from a local script to a deployed, scheduled service on Google Cloud Run, with health checks, run history, and retries.

projects.name: lead-qualifier
projects.description: Qualify scraped leads with rules or an LLM (0-100 score + reason) and measure the qualifier with a precision/recall eval harness. Zero runtime dependencies.

projects.name: scrape-sentinel
projects.description: The change-aware layer for any scraper: turn records into new / changed / removed, then alert and schedule. Zero runtime dependencies.

projects.name: repo-packager
projects.description: Download GitHub repos and deliver clean, deterministic, verifiable ZIPs (manifest + sha256). Standard-library Python, zero dependencies.

projects.name: bedrock
projects.description: A natural-language-to-SQL data agent with a stability harness: runs each question K times against a defended answer key and flags the ones that flap, with a CI gate that blocks reliability regressions.

projects.name: grounded-copy
projects.description: Generate on-brand product copy from your catalog, and prove it didn't invent anything. Deterministic grounding check + optional Claude layer.

projects.name: retell-sms-handler
projects.description: Deterministic In-Call SMS for Retell voice agents: consent gated, number resolved in code, every send logged. FastAPI + Twilio.

projects.name: source-of-truth
projects.description: Centralize scattered knowledge sources into one queryable base that flags cross-source conflicts, marks stale sources, and abstains honestly. Pure-Python, deterministic, no API key.

projects.name: record-refinery
projects.description: Raw business records in, a clean validated deduplicated dataset + a QA brief out. Email/phone/URL validated in code, dedup with an optional model-proposed canonical name. Deterministic, offline, 41 tests.

projects.name: doc-eval
projects.description: Field-level evaluation and release gate for LLM document extraction: exact golden set, per-field precision/recall, CI gate that blocks regressions

projects.name: multi-agent-analyst
projects.description: A multi-agent crew that answers business questions no single source can: a planner routes work to a self-correcting SQL agent and a BM25 doc retriever, a verifier feeds objections back, and every answer cites its evidence or honestly refuses.

projects.name: n8n-lead-triage
projects.description: AI lead triage in n8n: the workflow routes, a tested HTTP service decides, and low confidence or any model failure routes to a human instead of dropping the lead

projects.name: rag-chat
projects.description: Chat-with-your-docs widget: grounded answers from your documents with clickable citations, an honest "I don't know", and a real chat UI. Pure-Python retrieval, runs key-free in demo mode.

projects.name: voice-receptionist
projects.description: An AI phone receptionist for a multi-location business: books against a live agenda over Twilio, answers policy questions with abstention, hands off to humans, and logs every call. The model proposes; the code disposes.

projects.name: web-pilot
projects.description: A browser-use agent where the model proposes one action and code disposes: closed action vocabulary, guardrails (domain allowlist, no credential/payment fields, step budget), full audit trace. Runs key-free in a sandbox demo.

projects.name: mcp-listings
projects.description: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server exposing a property-listings dataset to Claude as typed tools

projects.name: sql-agent
projects.description: Ask a database questions in plain English. A text-to-SQL agent that writes, runs, and self-corrects its own SQL against a read-only connection, then answers with the numbers and an optional chart.

projects.name: rag-quality
projects.description: A RAG pipeline that measures retrieval quality instead of assuming it: BM25 + dense embeddings + RRF hybrid, an eval harness (hit@k, MRR, recall@k), and grounded answers that cite sources and abstain when unsure. Core runs key-free on CPU.

projects.name: docs-to-markdown
projects.description: Scrape any documentation or marketing site into a clean Markdown corpus: per-page Markdown + frontmatter, manifest, coverage report. JS rendering, code fidelity, framework-agnostic.

projects.name: pdf-extract
projects.description: Turn PDF documents into validated structured JSON. Pluggable OCR (Tesseract / AWS Textract) and extraction (regex / Anthropic / Bedrock). Runs locally with no cloud account; AWS + LLM adapters included.

projects.name: ai-watcher
projects.description: Monitor RSS/Atom feeds and turn new articles into structured AI summaries with Claude (scrape -> summarize -> digest). Delivers a ready answer, not raw data.

projects.name: mini-rag
projects.description: A small, working Retrieval-Augmented Generation API (FastAPI + Chroma + Claude). Ingest documents, ask questions, get answers grounded only in your data with cited sources.

projects.name: bcb-data-pipeline
projects.description: Daily ETL of Brazilian macroeconomic indicators (Selic, IPCA, FX) from the BCB SGS API. Python + pandas + GitHub Actions.

projects.name: web-scraper
projects.description: End-to-end Python project: Playwright scraper, SQLite storage, and Streamlit dashboard for books.toscrape.com
